title: Alignment Services & Plans — Appointment Booking Schedule
content:
Alignment visits under Alignment Services & Plans are booked as appointments. Bay time, how far ahead a slot may be booked, the minimum lead time, rescheduling and late arrival are set per line as follows.

| Line | Bay time reserved, minutes | Latest slot, calendar days after the booking date | Minimum hours between booking and slot start | Times one appointment may be moved before it must be booked as new | Minutes after slot start before an absent customer's slot is released | Fee for a missed appointment (USD) | Where included alignments may be performed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | 60 | 30 | 2 | 2 | 15 | 0.00 | any Crestline store |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | 75 | 30 | 2 | 2 | 15 | 0.00 | any Crestline store |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | 75 | 30 | 2 | 2 | 15 | 0.00 | any Crestline store |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | 75 | 30 | 2 | 2 | 15 | 0.00 | any Crestline store |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | 75 | 30 | 2 | 2 | 15 | 0.00 | any Crestline store |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | 90 | 30 | 4 | 2 | 15 | 0.00 | any Crestline store |

### Reading the schedule

- The lead time is counted in hours from the moment of booking to the slot start; the horizon is counted in calendar days after the booking date.
- A line allowing 2 moves allows one appointment chain of at most three bookings: the original booking and two reschedules.
- The missed-appointment fee is 0.00 on every line.

### Hypothetical cases

| Booking (hypothetical) | Line | Within the schedule? |
|---|---|---|
| Slot starts 3 hours after booking | Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | Yes — at least 2 hours |
| Slot starts 3 hours after booking | Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | No — fewer than 4 hours |
| Slot falls 31 calendar days after the booking date | any line | No — beyond 30 days |
| Third move of the same appointment | any line | No — at most 2 moves |
